features.cite: Zertal 2005 (Eng. Vol. 4) Site 119, p. 359 (Installations line, citing Eitam 2005)
features.quote: 5 basins and 2 cupmarks were found, dated to the LR period

date.basis: dated 'LR' (Late Roman); entry gives no absolute dates, so neither securely after nor up to 135 CE

notes: Five basins with no size or location: pool_def unclear, position none. The karstic recess NW of the structure 'served as a trough' (trough = not a pool), not coded. Plan fig. 240 shows only the tower, courtyard and terrace wall. 'Cisterns: none' recorded as C2 absence.
